name: left_elbow_angle
description: left elbow angle in degrees (180 = arm straight)

name: left_knee_angle
description: left knee angle in degrees (180 = leg straight)

name: left_upper_arm
description: which way the left upper arm goes from the shoulder

name: left_forearm
description: which way the left forearm goes from the elbow

name: left_elbow_turn
description: at the left elbow, which way the arm turns (image frame): left / right / straight

name: left_forearm_folds_in
description: the left forearm comes back toward the body

name: left_arm_straight
description: left arm straight

name: left_arm_bent
description: left arm clearly bent

name: left_arm_hanging
description: left arm hangs down by the side

name: left_arm_L
description: left upper arm goes down from the shoulder, then the arm turns at the elbow (forearm out or up: carrying, holding, gesturing)

name: left_arm_raised
description: left arm raised: the wrist is up from the shoulder (within 60 degrees of straight up)

name: left_arm_pointing
expression: left_arm_straight and dist(left_wrist, neck) > 0.9 and not goes(left_shoulder, left_wrist, "down", 30)
description: left arm extended away from the body (pointing, reaching)

name: left_pointing_direction
description: where the left arm points (image frame)

name: right_elbow_angle
description: right elbow angle in degrees (180 = arm straight)

name: right_knee_angle
description: right knee angle in degrees (180 = leg straight)

name: right_upper_arm
description: which way the right upper arm goes from the shoulder

name: right_forearm
description: which way the right forearm goes from the elbow

name: right_elbow_turn
description: at the right elbow, which way the arm turns (image frame): left / right / straight

name: right_forearm_folds_in
description: the right forearm comes back toward the body

name: right_arm_straight
description: right arm straight

name: right_arm_bent
description: right arm clearly bent

name: right_arm_hanging
description: right arm hangs down by the side

name: right_arm_L
description: right upper arm goes down from the shoulder, then the arm turns at the elbow (forearm out or up: carrying, holding, gesturing)

name: right_arm_raised
description: right arm raised: the wrist is up from the shoulder (within 60 degrees of straight up)

name: right_arm_pointing
expression: right_arm_straight and dist(right_wrist, neck) > 0.9 and not goes(right_shoulder, right_wrist, "down", 30)
description: right arm extended away from the body (pointing, reaching)

name: right_pointing_direction
description: where the right arm points (image frame)

name: hands_up
description: both wrists above the nose

name: arms_spread
expression: left_arm_straight and right_arm_straight and not goes(left_shoulder, left_wrist, "down", 45) and not goes(right_shoulder, right_wrist, "down", 45)
description: both arms straight and held out from the body

name: hand_near_face
description: a hand is at the face (eating, phoning, touching face)

name: hands_together
description: the two hands are together (clapping, holding one thing)

name: arms_crossed
description: arms folded across the chest

name: hands_on_hips
expression: dist(left_hand, left_hip) < 0.35 and dist(right_hand, right_hip) < 0.35 and left_arm_bent and right_arm_bent
description: both hands on the hips, elbows out

name: facing
expression: "sideways" if dist(left_shoulder, right_shoulder) < 0.35 else ("camera" if right_of(left_shoulder, right_shoulder) else "away")
description: torso facing the camera, away from it, or sideways (shoulders narrow relative to the torso). Facing the camera, the person's left shoulder is on the image right

name: head_toward
expression: "image right" if right_of(nose, neck) else "image left"
description: which side of the image the face is turned toward

name: upright
description: torso vertical (standing, sitting or kneeling, not lying or bent over)

name: torso_horizontal
description: torso horizontal (lying, on all fours, bent over)

name: on_all_fours
expression: torso_horizontal and left_arm_hanging and right_arm_hanging and (left_knee_angle < 120 or right_knee_angle < 120)
description: hands and knees on the ground

name: torso_lean
description: degrees the torso leans from vertical; positive = toward the image left

name: sitting
expression: upright and (goes(left_hip, left_knee, "left", 40) or goes(left_hip, left_knee, "right", 40) or goes(right_hip, right_knee, "left", 40) or goes(right_hip, right_knee, "right", 40)) and (left_knee_angle < 140 or right_knee_angle < 140)
description: upright torso, a thigh roughly horizontal and a knee bent

name: standing
expression: upright and left_knee_angle >= 150 and right_knee_angle >= 150 and below(left_ankle, left_knee) and below(right_ankle, right_knee)
description: upright with both legs straight under the body

name: squatting
description: both knees deeply bent, torso upright

name: wide_stance
description: feet far apart (walking, running, wide stance)

name: left_arm_proportions
description: left upper arm and forearm are about the same length (allowing for foreshortening)

name: left_leg_proportions
description: left thigh and shin are about the same length (allowing for foreshortening)

name: right_arm_proportions
description: right upper arm and forearm are about the same length (allowing for foreshortening)

name: right_leg_proportions
description: right thigh and shin are about the same length (allowing for foreshortening)

name: upper_arms_match
description: the two upper arms are of similar length

name: head_above_neck_if_upright
description: an upright person's nose is above the shoulders

name: eyes_near_nose
description: the eyes sit close to the nose
